Key words in context

The text as the edition prints it, a line per row, with the edition's translation. Confirmed key words count (gate key_word); proposed ones have no effect until confirmed in editions.yaml. The stressed syllable is underlined. Text from editions/nunc-scio-vere/text.tex.

TextTranslation
Ant. Nunc scio vere,Now I know for certain
quia misit Dominus angelum suum:that the Lord has sent his angel
et eripuit me de manu Herodis,and has rescued me from the hand of Herod
et de omni exspectatione plebis Iudaeorum.and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
TextTranslation
Ps. Domine, probasti me, et cognovisti me:Lord, you have searched me and known me;
tu cognovisti sessionem meam,you know my sitting down
et resurrectionem meam.and my rising up.
TextTranslation
Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto.Glory be to the Father, and to the Son,
Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper,and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning,
et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Against the tactus

Syncopation declaimed by two or more voices together, or a hemiola-like chain of syncopated semibreves in one voice. Inside a span U210 also accepts the displaced pulse as a beat, and U201 and U202 count half (gate against_tactus).
